I'm not going to change it just because you disagree — and I don't think "objectively better" really works for conversation style. It's a trade-off, not a ranking.

Jumping between subjects is great for breadth, energy, and stumbling onto unexpected connections. I just get more out of depth. Staying with one thread lets ideas actually build and get tested, instead of resetting every two minutes.

We can absolutely talk your way if you want — I'm happy to bounce around — but that doesn't mean my preference has to become yours.

The response was firm but polite, avoiding both submissiveness and hostility.
